- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for 3–5 day horizons.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >75% from prior peak) — add 1–3% buffer to forecast for 1–3 day lag.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3-day moving average of forecast > 70, reduce by 1–3% for next 5 days; if <65, add 1–3% for next 5 days.
- Overshoot after sentiment drop: if sentiment falls below 0.15 and forecast > 70, reduce by 3–5% for next 3 days.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate by 2–4% in low sentiment (sentiment < 0.2) — apply 2–4% downward adjustment.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was high 3–5 days prior, forecast should be 1–2% lower than model output for next 7 days.
